Written for cold storage warehouses, food processing plants, meat and poultry plants, dairies, ice cream plants and distribution centers.

Confirms melt water can drain before a defrost cycle starts.

Where to post it

Mount on the wall or support near the evaporator defrost drain line at eye level.

Refrigeration operators, plant maintenance leads, refrigeration contractors, cold-storage facility managers, food plant engineers.
